sections.text_helper: Section 43.4.15 "CRC hashing" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2110.
sections.section_content:
The CRC operator allows a 16-bit signature to be extracted for each frame, by hashing the
R,G,B components of all the frame pixels.
The computed CRC can be read in LTDC_CCRCR.
An expected CRC value can be configured: if the computed CRC does not match
theexpected CRC, the CRC interrupt is triggered. It allows a system test, letting the LTDC
run for hours, and be warned only if a failed frame occurs.
Parameters
• CRCEN in LTDC_GCR: activates the CRC computation
• ECRC in LTDC_ECRCR: expected 16-bit CRC value
• CCRC in LTDC_CCRCR: computed 16-bit CRC value
Default configuration
The CRC hashing is disabled with the default configuration after reset, with CRCEN=0.
